head.title: Reckon House · Design & Build
head.description: The portfolio of Jeremy Prasatik, an independent designer and developer in Texas. Apps, ecommerce, campaigns, brand systems, interiors, and AI tools, with case studies for each.
head.ogImageAlt: Reckon House. Work by Jeremy Prasatik: the Robert Rodriguez campaign, the Ivy Park launch, and the A.R.C. app.

index.intro: Reckon House. Jeremy Prasatik makes things across brand, product, and place: apps and ecommerce, campaigns and brand systems, photography and art direction, custom interiors, AI tools. Every study, in its own words, at the links below; ask the site anything about them.

statement.lead: I'm Jeremy Prasatik. I make things across brand, product, and place. Apps and ecommerce, campaigns and brand systems, photography and art direction, custom interiors, AI tools.

lines: Sites, stores and platforms, designed and shipped.
Native tools and AI products, built end to end.
Creative direction and execution for international brands.
Marks, type and patterns, on packaging, print and apparel.
Rooms designed like products, down to the hardware.
Pictures and lines saved from other people's work.

quotes.text:
Came up on a tornado, sunlight in the sky
I went around all day with the moon sticking in my eye

And this old man in front of me wearing canes and ruby rings
It's like containing an explosion when he sings
With every chance to set himself on fire
He just ends up doing the same thing
What you got ain't nothin' new. This country is hard on people. You can't stop what's coming. It ain't all waiting on you. That's vanity.

news: A.R.C. launched on the App Store
Point the camera at a room and it names what is there, estimates replacement value, and shows the gap against your policy as a dollar amount. Solo, end to end: concept, code, brand, go-to-market.
A.R.C. is on the App Store.
Sally OS is rolling out to the enterprise

Eight apps, an AI strategist with 21 tools, an asset hub and a store-associate site, built from inside the marketing team in about four months. It reads live signals and proposes campaigns on its own now.
Sally OS is rolling out to the enterprise.
Faux Reel went out as an open repo
A sizzle reel with no footage: still photographs run through fourteen transitions in CSS, no video file anywhere. A 4.8KB web component, built in a day with Claude Code.
Faux Reel is out as an open repo.

info: Creative technologist. AI development. Brand systems. Digital design. Interior design. Independent, Texas. Design and build. I love the work.
Coffee. Music. Ideas. To do lists. Claude. IPAs, and lagers, and stouts, and ales.
